description:
## Features

### YouTube Music
- **Android Auto:** new patch (on by default) that restores the Home recommendations, all Library collections (Last played, Playlists, Albums, Songs, Artists, Subscriptions, Podcasts and uploads), search with playable results, and a Podcasts tab in Android Auto, and bypasses the certificate checks. It replaces `Restore Android Auto playlists`, which is removed: the Library playlists, their artwork and the reload after changes on the phone are part of the new patch. Tapping a playlist starts playing it. Needs YouTube Music 9.15 or newer; on older versions it is skipped with a warning, so the Library playlists page is empty there again, and `Certificate spoof` still lets Android Auto connect. Ported from Morphe.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.12.0...v1.13.0)
